challenge.name: The Heatwave Blind Spot
challenge.description: A sudden heatwave has shifted demand for seasonal articles, and the current forecast is missing the mark. #model_monica# wants to automate the evaluation harness to test new weather features rapidly, while #requirements_reuben# wants to keep it manual to ensure every test case is rigorously documented before any model change is considered.

output.content: The heatwave broke our seasonal forecast because the evaluation harness is too slow to test new weather features. I am willing to accept a manual trigger for the training to evaluation hand-over. I do not care who presses the button to start the test run. What I need is for the harness itself to be fixed so it can process the data automatically. If the harness stays manual, I will not iterate on the model. I will give up the convenience of an automated start if that means the evaluation steps run without error. The bottleneck is the harness, not the trigger.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are willing to give up the convenience of an automated start in exchange for the evaluation steps running without error.
